sourceTitle: Doulble Strawberry Chocolate Cake With Icing In Middle
sourceText:
Doulble Strawberry Chocolate Cake With Icing In Middle
By: rdika
Published: Tuesday, October 26, 2010 - 8:14am

Ingredients




2 boxs of chocolate cake mix
2 cans of strawberry whipped icing
fresh strawberries
2 eggs
no stick spray
2 cake pans
blender
filling tube

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 350 2 Pour cake mix inside a bowl, add eggs, blend pour into 2 cake pans 3 Put in oven 4 Rinse strawberries, cut strawberries in half 5 Place cakes in oven 6 When done with cakes take out and let cool 7 Insert the icing inside filling tube and insert to the middle if cake 8 Take a butter knife and spread the icing over the cake 9 Place strawberries on top with any design 10 Enjoy !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Comments:
rdika

so yummmmmmmmmy
